notes: Hophal's only attestation (Ezek.46.22) is marked in the WLC with Masoretic puncta extraordinaria (an extra point over every letter, U+05C4 -- a scribal/editorial annotation, not niqqud or cantillation): the raw corpus text is מְׄהֻׄקְׄצָׄעֽׄוֹׄתׄ. clean_heb() only strips the standard cantillation range (U+0591-05AF) and doesn't touch these, so the heb value above was cleaned by hand (U+05C4 removed) for this one entry per an explicit decision, rather than extending the pipeline -- clean_heb() itself is untouched, so any future root that hits the same marks will need the same manual treatment (or a pipeline fix) again. translit is unaffected either way: transliterate() already silently ignores the unmapped U+05C4 codepoint, so pipeline output and the hand-cleaned string transliterate identically to "mhuqtzaot".
